verdict.rationale: Temporal can be self-hosted on Docker, Kubernetes, or manual infrastructure, so users can place the Temporal Service and its data wherever they deploy it. Multi-cluster replication and archival to blob storage add some control over where Workflow state lives. However, residency control here is only implied by self-hosting, not documented as a region or residency feature. missing for 10: explicit Temporal Cloud region selection or data-residency documentation, residency or compliance guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
